highlights: The AI agent landscape is rapidly evolving with new foundational infrastructure and specialized capabilities, including a zero-trust P2P network and agents for highly optimized code generation.

Significant advancements in AI models and deployment tools are enhancing performance and accessibility, featuring SOTA streaming TTS, ultrafast frontier model inference, and a new open-source multimodal agentic model.

Major companies like OpenAI and Google are focusing on critical aspects such as data privacy for frontier models, democratizing AI development, and addressing ethical considerations in national security and global AI equity.

agents.title: Google Open-Sources SAM: Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents
agents.summary: Google has open-sourced SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh), a zero-config, zero-trust P2P overlay network enabling autonomous AI agents to discover and interact securely across diverse environments without exposing internal endpoints.

agents.title: ByteDance & Tsinghua Introduce CUDA Agent for Optimized GPU Kernel Generation
agents.summary: ByteDance Seed and Tsinghua AIR released CUDA Agent, an agentic reinforcement learning system that trains large language models to write GPU kernels that outperform compiler-generated code, targeting stubborn performance gaps.

agents.title: FinSkillBench: New Benchmark for AI Agents in Investment Management
agents.summary: FinSkillBench is introduced as an evaluation suite to measure AI agent effectiveness in financial domain skills for investment management tasks, emphasizing that reliable procedural skills are as crucial as model choice for high-stakes applications.

models.title: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer: Local, Agentic, Multimodal, and Open Source
models.summary: Meta introduced Muse Glimmer, a new open-source model that is local, agentic, and multimodal, providing a powerful and versatile foundation for developing advanced AI applications with enhanced flexibility.

models.title: Cartesia Ships Sonic-3.6: Streaming TTS Model Leads Speech Leaderboards
models.summary: Cartesia released Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech model built on state space models, which now leads both Artificial Analysis speech leaderboards with sub-90ms time-to-first-audio, offering high-performance speech synthesis.

models.title: OpenAI Previews Ultrafast Mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at 14X Speed
models.summary: OpenAI is previewing Ultrafast mode, a new API service tier running GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14 times faster and delivering up to 750 output tokens per second, significantly boosting inference speed for developers.

tools.title: NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect Public Preview: HF to C++ in Two Commands
tools.summary: NVIDIA's TensorRT Model Connect, now in public preview, is an Apache-2.0 project enabling direct conversion from Hugging Face or local checkpoints to end-to-end native C++ TensorRT inference with just two commands, eliminating intermediate ONNX export.

tools.title: DeepSeek AI Releases MIT-Licensed Agent Harness in Developer Preview
tools.summary: DeepSeek AI released DeepSeek Harness v0.1 in developer preview, an MIT-licensed agent framework where every capability is a Cordis plugin, offering flexible runtime modes and provider-agnostic model routing for builders.

tools.title: Google Sheets Canvas Brings Spreadsheet Data to Life with AI
tools.summary: Google introduced Sheets canvas, an AI-powered feature for Google Sheets that allows users to transform data into interactive dashboards, custom study trackers, and more using simple prompts, enhancing data visualization and productivity.

companies.title: OpenAI Offers Zero Data Retention for Frontier Models, Previews Private Safety Processing
companies.summary: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing, a move to enhance data privacy and trust for enterprises deploying frontier AI models in sensitive environments.

companies.title: Replit Expands Software Creation Access with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna
companies.summary: Replit introduced Free Mode, powered by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna, allowing anyone to turn ideas into working software without concerns about token costs, significantly democratizing access to AI-assisted development.

companies.title: OpenAI Launches Initiative to Strengthen Democratic Oversight in National Security
companies.summary: OpenAI is leading an initiative to bolster democratic oversight of AI within national security, providing government institutions with tools, training, and expertise to responsibly integrate and manage AI technologies.

learning.title: Guide: Auditing Preference Biases & Fine-Tuning LLMs with DPO, TRL, LoRA
learning.summary: This tutorial offers an end-to-end workflow for fine-tuning language models using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), demonstrating how to audit biases in datasets like Anthropic HH-RLHF and implement robust training with TRL and LoRA.

learning.title: Complete Guide: Fine-Tuning Tool-Calling LLMs with XYZ-Aquila-SFT and Qwen3
learning.summary: This comprehensive guide provides a complete pipeline for fine-tuning tool-calling language models, covering trajectory parsing, structured tool-call extraction, Qwen-compatible ChatML rendering, and efficient LoRA adaptation using PyTorch.

learning.title: Google/Kaggle's AI Agents Intensive Course Reaches 353,000 Learners
learning.summary: Google AI Blog recapped its successful AI Agents Intensive with Kaggle, a no-cost course that engaged over 353,000 participants in building and deploying the next generation of AI agents, fostering widespread AI literacy.
